connector.name: QRcodly
connector.registryDescription: Create, manage, and share QR codes and short URLs
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.qrcodly.de over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace de.qrcodly, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
